ios.desc:
Poemz allows you to: 
* Anonymously share your poetry * 
* Read thousands of poems from users around the world *  
* Browse user submitted poems by rating, category, and more *  
* Rate others' work *
* Keep track of your favorite poems *
* Share poems by email, Facebook, and Twitter *

Share you innermost thoughts, or just a clever barb. Discuss love, or read a haiku about water fountains. Give your creative side a voice and submit your poetic thoughts to a community of like minded users. But keep it anonymous!

All original content submitted to Poemz is put into the public domain. Copyrighted and overtly offensive content will be deleted and users who submit copyrighted or overtly offensive content will be banned.

quotes.text:
Poemz - anonymous poetry app for iOS:
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/poemz/id476811547?mt=8

Includes a web backend which allows poems from the app to be shared on social networks.
http://poets-anonymous.appspot.com

The app has good reviews and thousands of submitted poems in its database, backed by Parse.

Monetization is through ads and the sale of credits to submit poems beyond the 5 credits you get with the app.  I have done 0 marketing so have not been able to see how far monetization can be taken - right now it's quite low.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Do you have a side project you want to sell?
